title: Sunrise Protocol
prompt: dance pop euro pop, uk garage, fast and high energy
description: A high-energy anthemic euro-pop sunrise anthem driven by a soaring sawtooth lead melody, punchy TR-909 drums, and shimmering piano accent chords. It builds from a stripped intro through a euphoric peak — layering bassline, garage rhythms, and choir-like harmonics — before stripping back to a glittering outro.
